title: Closing-auction imbalance predicts the last minutes (index funds / leveraged ETFs must trade at the close): QQQ imbalance -> NQ, intraday-flat
registered: 2026-10-20, BEFORE the imbalance data is downloaded
data: Databento XNAS.ITCH imbalance schema for QQQ 2018-06..2026-09 (Nasdaq closing cross: first publication 15:50 ET); NQ 1-minute 2018-26
signal: the first QQQ closing-cross imbalance message at/after 15:50:00 ET each day: side (buy / sell) and paired/imbalance quantity; dollar imbalance = imbalance qty x reference price
rule: if the dollar imbalance exceeds its trailing 20-day median (absolute), take the imbalance side in NQ from the open of the 15:51 bar to the last price before 16:00; 0.5 units; 2 x cost_frac (micro)
pass: 2018-20 > 0, 2021-23 >= 0.3, 2024-26 >= 0.3; if it passes, SPY imbalance -> ES ($25.87) is the confirmation test (pre-registered here: same rule, must be > 0 in all three splits)
